brand.name: Ferrari
brand.tagline: Italian sports car maker from Maranello
brand.description: Ferrari is an Italian sports car maker based in Maranello; the first Ferrari-badged car was built in 1947. In India it sells imported cars through authorised dealers Select Cars (New Delhi and Bengaluru) and Navnit Motors (Mumbai).

models.engine: 2992 cc twin-turbo V6 + electric motor (plug-in hybrid)

items: 3.0-litre 120° V6 with turbochargers inside the vee, 663 cv
Rear electric motor, 167 cv; 7.45 kWh high-voltage battery
eDrive electric mode up to 135 km/h; 25 km claimed electric range (GTB)
ABS evo with 6-way Chassis Dynamic Sensor (6w-CDS)
Magnetorheological dampers and brake-by-wire with 'Aero' calipers
Optional Assetto Fiorano pack with Multimatic dampers and carbon-fibre aero parts
Active rear spoiler integrated in the rear bumper
296 GTS: retractable hard top, opens or closes in 14 s at up to 45 km/h
Optional Lexan rear screen and 250 LM-inspired livery with Assetto Fiorano pack

highlights: Plug-in hybrid 3.0-litre V6 with an electric motor, 830 cv combined
0–100 km/h in 2.9 s and top speed over 330 km/h (claimed)
Up to 135 km/h and 25 km on electric power alone (GTB, claimed)
Sold as the 296 GTB berlinetta and the 296 GTS retractable hard-top spider

variants.name: 296 GTS
features: Retractable hard top: 14 s at up to 45 km/h

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India. 296 GTB: Autocar India Delhi ex-showroom (unchanged since the Aug 2022 launch). 296 GTS: Autocar India no longer has a GTS price page, but its May 2026 report lists the GTS in Ferrari's Indian line-up; ₹6.24 crore is its May 2023 launch figure (ex-showroom, city not stated). CarWale shows ₹5,90,27,027 Delhi ex-showroom for the GTS, so check this one. Hybrids are not part of Ferrari's FTA-linked reduced order prices. No India price found for the 296 Speciale / Speciale A, so they are left out. Dimensions are the GTB's; the GTS is 1191 mm tall and weighs 1540 kg dry (GTB 1470 kg). Top speed is published as '>330 km/h'. Colours are Ferrari paint names listed for the 296 by Autocar India; Tailor Made colours cost extra. Ferrari doesn't publish an airbag count. No ARAI figure.

variants.name: Amalfi Spider

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options). These are the reduced order prices Ferrari dealers have quoted since May 2026 in expectation of the India-EU FTA. They are estimates: the final price depends on the FTA terms and EUR-INR, and buyers who take delivery before the FTA takes effect pay the earlier price. The coupe was announced at ₹5.59 crore in Feb 2026, with bookings open and deliveries not expected before 2027. The Spider launched on 17 July 2026 at ₹4.6 crore. Dimensions are the coupe's; the Spider is 1305 mm tall and weighs 1556 kg dry (coupe 1470 kg), with 0–200 km/h in 9.4 s (coupe 9.0 s). The passenger-display size is given inconsistently, so it is not stated. Colours are those named on ferrari.com for the Amalfi and Amalfi Spider. Ferrari doesn't publish an airbag count. No ARAI figure.

highlights: Naturally aspirated 6.5-litre V12 with 830 cv and 678 Nm
0–100 km/h in 2.9 s and top speed over 340 km/h (coupe, claimed)

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options). These are the reduced order prices dealers have quoted since May 2026 in expectation of the India-EU FTA. They are estimates, and buyers who take delivery before the FTA takes effect pay the earlier ₹8.50 crore (coupe) / ₹9.15 crore (Spider) announced on 31 Jan 2025. The 12Cilindri Manuale (revealed July 2026) has no India price and is left out. Spider figures: 0–100 km/h in under 3.0 s, 0–200 km/h in under 8.3 s, 1620 kg dry (coupe 1560 kg). Top speed is published as '>340 km/h'. Autocar India lists 6.45 kmpl, but that is not an ARAI claim, so efficiency is null. Some listings (CarDekho, ZigWheels) wrongly show this car as upcoming in 2028. Colours are a selection of Ferrari names from ferrari.com and Autocar India. Ferrari doesn't publish an airbag count.

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options). This is the reduced order price dealers have quoted since May 2026 in expectation of the India-EU FTA. It is an estimate, and buyers who take delivery before the FTA takes effect pay the earlier ₹10.50 crore set in Feb 2024. Autocar India suggests new orders may not be delivered until 2027–28. The optional Handling Speciale configuration is not separately priced. Ferrari doesn't call the car an SUV; it is filed here as SUV for body-type filtering. Fuel tank and boot capacity are not on ferrari.com, so left null. Top speed is published as '>310 km/h'. Colours are a selection of Ferrari names listed for the Purosangue by Autocar India. Ferrari doesn't publish an airbag count. No ARAI figure.

models.notes: Price not published by the brand; from Autocar India (Delhi ex-showroom, before options), announced 9 Feb 2026. Deliveries are due from the second half of 2026. It is a hybrid, so it is not part of the FTA-linked reduced-price scheme. The 849 Testarossa Spider is sold elsewhere, but no India price was found, so it is left out. The SF90 Stradale / Spider it replaces is no longer listed by Autocar India. Top speed is published as '>330 km/h'. The torque figure is for the V8 only; Ferrari doesn't publish a combined figure. Colours are those named on ferrari.com for the 849 Testarossa. Ferrari doesn't publish an airbag count. No ARAI figure.
